title: Aureline M5 transparency-report snapshot diff
description: Canonical per-domain report-snapshot-diff record minted by the transparency-report and snapshot-diff lane over the frozen M5 supported-line-transparency matrix. Turns a change in an active supported line's published transparency / upstream-health report into visible, machine-checkable program truth instead of a forgotten repository-maintenance note: it records the diff scope a snapshot change sits in — a health-status change (a critical-upstream / backup-maintainer / signer-quorum / emergency-authority / sustainment-sponsor section moved to a worse or better health state versus the prior published snapshot), a coverage narrowing (backup-maintainer, signer-quorum, or emergency-authority coverage narrowed against the prior snapshot), or a red-risk drift (a new or changed unresolved red-risk upstream / signing dependency emerged versus the prior snapshot). Names the diff scope, binds the resolved supported-line identity, the affected report-section reference, the previous-versus-current snapshot reference, and the active diff reason so support, procurement, and OSS-governance surfaces can show trend and drift and follow the same currentness rules as internal release control rather than rereading raw maintenance notes by hand. Downstream surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a line's upstream-health posture by hand. Public-safe and internal-only variants share one canonical record identity; raw secret values, private endpoints, and privileged incident / security internals never cross this boundary.
